component.name: Octo
component.summary: A music player for Subsonic, Navidrome and Octo servers

description.p: Listen to your music from Subsonic, Navidrome and Octo servers. Browse albums, artists and playlists, follow synced lyrics, and keep songs for offline listening.
Octo includes gapless playback, an equalizer, ReplayGain, media keys and a mini player.
